info.name: SNAP Retailer Location Data Retailers API

params.name: where
params.description: SQL-92 WHERE clause evaluated against the layer's fields, e.g. State='CA', Store_Type='Supermarket', or 1=1 to match all records.

params.name: outFields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, or * for all fields.

params.name: geometry
params.description: Geometry (e.g. an envelope or point) to spatially filter results, used together with geometryType and spatialRel.

params.name: distance
params.description: Buffer distance for a proximity/radius search around a point geometry.

params.name: orderByFields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to sort by, e.g. "State ASC, City ASC".

params.name: returnCountOnly
params.description: If true, returns only the count of matching records instead of the records themselves.

params.name: resultOffset
params.description: Number of matching records to skip, for pagination.

params.name: resultRecordCount
params.description: Maximum number of records to return. The service enforces a maxRecordCount of 1,000 per request.

params.name: outSR
params.description: Output spatial reference well-known ID. Native service SR is 102100/3857 (Web Mercator); 4326 returns WGS84 lat/lon geometry.

items.docs: Queries the SNAP retailer location layer with an optional SQL-style WHERE clause, field selection, spatial filter, sorting, distinct values, and offset-based pagination. Confirmed live: a nationwide count query (where=1=1, returnCountOnly=true) returned 254,048 authorized retailer records as of the review date; a filtered query (where=State='DC') returned real convenience store, grocery, and supermarket records with names and street addresses.
